notes.content: [h1]Lolis's Birthday Festival[/h1][p][/p][p]Today marks Lolis's second birthday! This is already the second birthday our studio has celebrated for Lolis. Compared to last year's explosive growth, this year has been one of steady development. notes.title: [v1.10.40] New animation loading feature and other updates from the PastHalfYear
notes.content:
Wishing everyone a happy Halloween from two days ago! It's been quite some time since I last wrote an update log. To let you all know that we haven't just been chirping aimlessly but have actually updated with many new contents, I've put together an update log.

If there are things you don't understand, the wiki is also being created, and another announcement will be made upon its release!

[h1]Major Updates Section[/h1]
[h2]Photo Gallery[/h2]
Do you want VPet wallpapers or emojis? Come check out the photo gallery! Refer to the Mid-Autumn Festival update notes for more details.
https://steamcommunity.com/games/1920960/announcements/detail/6947454238669224562
[h2]New Cache Generation Method[/h2]
The startup time after the first cache generation or deletion has been reduced from 4 minutes to under 10 seconds!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43530340/9326c99c6a19ca4fdcf02e064aff5fb48417262a.png[/img]
(While it may use more performance, the time saved is significant! Additionally, tests show that it can adaptively load on computers of all performance levels.)
[h2]Loading Cache Progress Display[/h2]
No more waiting in vain with the message "Attempting to load animation and generate cache. This step may take a while. Please be patient." Now, you will be informed about the loading progress.
[strike]Although with the new cache generation method, it's now harder to see this progress bar.[/strike]
[h2]Badge Recovery and Data Repair[/h2]
Accidentally lost your hash check badge? Is there a discrepancy between your Steam game time and in-game statistics? 
You can now resolve this issue using the Data Repair feature in the settings.
[h2]Animation and Image File Size Optimization[/h2]
All animation and food files have been optimized using File.

[h1]Animation Update Section[/h1]
More random idle animations are here!
[b]Yawning[/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43530340/f7b45b3d8879777643840418d0db9e933930d314.gif[/img]
[b]Playing Ball[/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43530340/ef5507a103714a7ab9a3498ab518e6a2f65d6a0a.gif[/img]
[b]Meow![/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43530340/093a9d98f4fe325b7104ec5664d4f0664b9149ad.gif[/img]
Jump rope has moved to work: play
New pen spinning animation added
New learning: Calligraphy

notes.title: Happy Mid-Autumn Festival & Photo Gallery Update
notes.content:
The moon of old is no longer seen, yet this moon once shone upon Lolisi.
It's the annual Mid-Autumn Festival again. Do you still remember the three types of mooncakes that Lolis made for you last year.
This year, we must also reunite with Lolis~
 
 [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43530340/ecb4630b5f2ac9aa3fb5fb50e1a6b7d7f7ccedca.png[/img]
 
[h1]Mid-Autumn Festival Update: Photo Gallery[/h1]
New feature: [b]Photo Gallery[/b] accessible from the system tray
All publicly available photos of "VPet Simulator" at the current stage have been added as task rewards.
It contains most of the images from the "VPet Simulator" including emojis, GIFs, CGs, etc.
Masters, you can unlock the corresponding pictures by completing tasks.
The tasks can be unlocked gradually through daily gameplay, and most of them can also be purchased directly with money if you don't want to grind.
Unlocking an image will trigger a notification pop-up. In the photo gallery, you can view the image details, which include the image name, unlock time, and a brief description of the image. Additionally, you can export or copy the image.
 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43530340/fcb9d3a11fa65611d786fc3aa87c2bc4861085b2.png[/img]
 
The photo gallery will continue to update, solving the troubles of players who cannot obtain the original images of VPets.
[b]Note: The content in the photo gallery is not for commercial use[/b]
Finally, Lolis wishes all masters a happy Mid-Autumn Festival and a happy reunion.

notes.title: Lolis' Birthday Celebration & Birthday Re-creation Celebration & Update
notes.content:
[h1]Lolis's Birthday Celebration[/h1]
Today is Lolis's birthday, which Lolis has been looking forward to for a long time, and she almost couldn't sleep last night.
PS: Actually, Lolis fell asleep right away and her saliva flowed all over the pillow.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43530340/ef22022a1b06daf1421c7b981f1caccad6234333.png[/img]
Thank you for your enthusiastic support over the past year. We have experienced a lot in this year, and Lolisi has gradually grown up. From the beginning with only basic movements to the current variety of animations. The initial zero DLC and few mods, now have multiple DLC, and the mod works in the creative workshop are also increasing. All of these are inseparable from the help of all the players. LBGame Studio and Lolisi thank all the masters for their companionship, thank you all! Please give us more guidance next year!
 
[h1]Birthday Commemoration: A Second Creation Exhibition[/h1]
[h2]Alright, it's time to open presents! [/h2]
15 players have provided artwork of siblings related to VPet Simulator, and now Lolis will share them with all players.
https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=LagPTbLpFP0

Note: Secondary creators can submit/send their works to any platform at will, and we do not impose any restrictions on this
 
[h2]We will also conduct a vote for birthday tribute fan creations, with the top 5 winners receiving an additional artist's autograph and double rewards. [/h2]
The voting rules will be the same as the previous DLC voting. The players will vote for the artwork of siblings for the birthday celebration of VPet Simulator, and rank them by the number of votes. The voting is 17 out of 5.
The voting period ends on August 19th
https://forms.gle/Jf24MyCiFXHarMaD7
 
[h1]Anniversary Celebration Update[/h1]
The production team also prepared a birthday gift for Lolis, which they shared with all the players
 
[h2]Birthday Live Wallpaper[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43530340/d77646469545dc093b175804d96c6c36f72ac38f.png[/img]
Subscription link:
https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=3306197508
Video source file download link: https://drive.google.com/file/d/1wrKE2x-7UWe71bb-U22Ma451HNLwt899/view?usp=sharing
 
[h2]New Animation[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43530340/ba8be305e233aa6afef644ef3173f72b911d518a.gif[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43530340/8e56e5dcd18bb900e577e3210cbc0f89f549cbdc.gif[/img]
And new job, idle and other animations! ( The new work is still in progress, and it is expected to be updated tonight)
 
[h2]New Mod[/h2]
Cloud save (not STEAM cloud save)
https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=3307842583
Due to the instability of Steam's cloud save feature, we have built our own game cloud save system. It automatically backs up save files to our servers and allows for easy viewing and loading at any time.
This MOD is specifically designed for players who need to frequently switch between different Steam accounts/computers, experience poor connections to the Steam network, and want to save their progress with greater peace of mind and security
 
[h1]Finally, Happy Birthday! Lolis![/h1]

notes.content:
We are updating VPet Simulator v1.10.

[h1]New Features[/h1]
[h2]Online function[/h2]
Master can now freely [b]create online rooms[/b] or [b]join rooms[/b].
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43530340/b0e2b68cf5814bfee5e371e1b9adc29eaf554f6b.png[/img]
You can interact with your friend's VPet in the room, synchronize the pet and interaction status, support feeding, petting, chatting and other functions.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43530340/92c748f8d6009e61b20519694dd318a21e13632f.png[/img]
Creative Workshop support, animations/items for mods that both players subscribe to together are displayed
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43530340/e2f3da440ed19e046a1907c83547918d415ff034.png[/img]
Future Official Online Mod Case: Lolis Race
And in the future, players will be able to play online in the VPet hut in the dlc, and friends will be able to interact with the furniture in the hut, and so on.

[h2]Theme & font modification[/h2]
Support for customized themes and fonts, and support for creative workshops.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43530340/de83c3b835304ef50d7dcbdbed2d3da839fd5a64.png[/img]

[h2]Data related updates[/h2]
[h3]Work panel[/h3]
Added a new job panel with multiplier adjustment, so you don't have to worry about not being able to use your low-level jobs when you level up!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43530340/469d518a4e676f968f189e25dde71b60783db6cc.png[/img]
With the multiplier adjustment, you can freely choose the consumption multiplier and profit rate, and if you want to feed less often, you can choose to lower the multiplier. If you want to make a quick and high profit, you can choose to higher the multiplier.

[h3]Data Optimization[/h3]
Optimized the work income model, removed the index calculation data from the income, and added the function of auto-calculating the reasonable work.

[h3]Leveling up the data limit[/h3]
Player data cap increases with player level
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43530340/8c87767061a35bb75a61f9c6278680cd54353cde.png[/img]

[h3]Breakthrough system designed for players with thousands of hours[/h3]
Redesigned the experience/leveling system, and designed a special breakout system for players over 1000 levels.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43530340/84a8db0b42cd34faa0a33df374a3bfa3cefe5207.png[/img]
If you encountered data overflow in the previous 1.09, you will also receive level compensation based on gameplay time in v1.10 version

[h1]Module Compatibility[/h1]
1.10 is a major update, which adjusts some structure and upgrades the project to dotnet8. Some mods may change.
Basically, except for the code plugin, all other plugins will be automatically compatible, even if marked in red: 'low version' will not affect the load
If you want to upgrade your mod, you can refer to the tutorials at
https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/1920960/view/4143947429362624603

[h3]At the same time, MOD Maker supports one-click upgrading of non-code plugins[/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43530340/b3b11ad16379bb6b5ddd2baa5bdf682eb374dc16.png[/img]

[b]PR Any% Disable Reader Disable Read Aloud IGT: 0 : 00 : 11.4514 Successfully reached! [/b]

[h1]Detailed update next:[/h1]

[h2]Guest List details[/h2]
Pets and interactions will be synchronized during online play, with support for feeding, petting, and chatting.
You can choose to disable the interaction option, other players can only feed and talk.
The Guest List has been carefully tested and processed, and will not be broken due to online.
If you don't enable the Guest List, no one will be able to join your game. The Guest List is implemented using SteamAPI, no server content.

[h3]Synchronization rules for online mods[/h3]
Animation Mods: Only mods that are enabled by the pet owner and subscribed to by other players will be synchronized.
Food/Item Mods: Only mods that are enabled by the pet owner and subscribed to by other players will synchronize food (and be able to be fed).
Code Plugin Mods: If you send a code plugin mod for a special function, such as starting a game, and the other player doesn't have the code plugin, they won't react. However, if you send existing commands, such as displaying animations/interacting/talking, there will be a reaction.
Work and other mods: do not synchronize the work content, only show the work animation, work animation logic synchronization refer to the previous Bring the Animation Mods.

[h3]Feeding data validity rules[/h3]
Food will be fed to your online friends only after the following judgments.
Feeder: Must have 'Small Marker' (no cheats/overmodel mods)
Food: All attributes must be gained, the price must be greater than 1 and less than 1000, and the food must pass the Overmodding check.
being fed: Food with a limit of $1,000 for a single online.

If the feed works, it will say 'Your friend bought you the food name for $money', otherwise it will not show the price.

[h2]Breakthrough System Rules[/h2]
We have redesigned the experience/leveling system and designed a special breakthrough system for players above level 1000.
Whenever a player reaches a breakthrough level (initially 1000, +100 for each breakthrough), they will return to level 100(*breakthroughs), and the breakthrough level will be +1.
Although the level drops, the stamina/mood limit will be higher than the same level before the breakthrough, and the favor limit will be retained.

Calculation of Maximum Stamina
100 + (int)(Math.Pow(Level * (1 + Number of breakthroughs), 0.75) * 4).
Mood Max Calculation
100 + (int)(Math.Pow(Level * (1 + Number of breakthroughs), 0.75) * 2);
Maximum calculation of favorability
+10 for each level

notes.title: VPet v1.10 announced! Includes multiplie, operating multiplier and more
notes.content:
[h1]We are very pleased to announce our latest update v1.10[/h1]
You can currently update the 1.10 beta from the test branch.  See the bottom of the announcement for how to update.
Details on how to update mods/adjustments for developers will be provided in the next announcement.
The mod maker is not available at the moment / the solution may be buggy.

[h2]About the Guest List[/h2]
[h3]Friends online[/h3]
Now you can play online with your friends, create Guest Lists and interact with other friends!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43530340/0571cd4ef6bd4eb97268019f54003cb79c6aa611.png[/img]
If you start the game in steam or have steam open when you start the game, you can see a new option in Interactions Guest List
Once you have created a Guest List, friends can join your Guest List, or you can invite them to join via your steam friends list.
Players with Guest Lists enabled will have a status of "can join"
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43530340/acaaadcd3a5259a6e5e04d6889c88c7da4887f8e.png[/img]
If you don't enable the Guest List, no one will be able to join your game. Guest List functionality is implemented using SteamAPI, no server content.

[h3]Interact with friends[/h3]
Pets and interactions are synchronized online, with support for feeding, petting, and chatting.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43530340/768cd244c6d74800d6ca0e6e2e9422ed333b991b.png[/img]
Right mouse click on a friend's pet to open the menu bar
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43530340/527a85a848391823bbb7a6c20f89afe2dab6b4e2.png[/img]

[h3]Support for Creative Workshops[/h3]
Animations/items of mods subscribed to by both players can be displayed.
At the same time, online related interface has been supported and open source, mod developers can also use the interface to write some two-player/multiplayer mini-games.
In the future, there will be an official online mod case study: Lolis Race.

[h2]Data update[/h2]
[h3]Job Panel[/h3]
Added a new work panel with multiplier adjustment, so you don't have to worry about the animations that look good at low levels not working at high levels anymore.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43530340/77eec67c473d5ee117585c13fa62b3f50873291b.png[/img]
By adjusting the multiplier, you can freely choose the consumption multiplier and profit rate, and if you want to feed less often, you can choose to lower the multiplier. If you want to make a quick and high profit, you can choose to lower the multiplier.

[h3]Data Optimization[/h3]
At the same time, we have optimized the working earnings model, so that it will not be more efficient than learning as in version 1.09. We have also removed the index calculation data from the earnings.
We also added a new function to automatically calculate the reasonable work, through the gradient descent method to adaptively calculate the reasonable data based on the current data, instead of resetting to the default value.

[h3]Leveling up the data cap[/h3]
In version 1.10, the player data cap will increase with player level.

[h3]A breakout system for players with thousands of hours[/h3]
We've redesigned the way the experience/leveling system is designed, and created a special breakout system for players over 1000 levels.
Whenever a player reaches a breakthrough level (initially 1000, +100 per breakthrough), they will return to level 100(*number of breakthroughs), and the breakthrough level will be +1.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43530340/c8e65b6465071140c0d9f85e1c6a63c2e2b4fb90.png[/img]
Although the level drops, the stamina/mood limit will be higher than the same level before the breakthrough, and the favor limit will be retained!

[h2]About Module Compatibility[/h2]
Since 1.10 is a major update, some structure adjustments have been made and the project has been upgraded to dotnet8. Some of the mods may change.
Work: Adaptive calculation of reasonable values is provided, and the mod maker will follow up with auto-calculation.
Animation: No changes
Code plugin: not working at all, need to upgrade project to dotnet8, will post a tutorial in the next announcement.
Version: Need to change 109 -> 11000, the new version number is 1.10.00, won't be stuck version for a long time like 1.09

[h2]Updated to beta v1.10[/h2]
To participate in the beta, please see the following.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43530340/cfe0a461b9815f2ea724bc80dec9cfb14b52e04c.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43530340/ceba315496458992c9cbf394833e7b190476dccc.png[/img]

notes.title: Commonly Fail to Open Solutions & Compile VPet Source Code v2
notes.content:
Using VPet problem solutions / compilation to see the exact cause

[h1]Solutions to Common Problems[/h1]
Here are some solutions to common problems, other VPets that are fault tolerant have tried to be fault tolerant themselves

[h2]Opened flashback/can't see anything/can't open[/h2]
If you can open it before, but now it won't open, you can try to close the mod/reset the archive through the VPET problem solver - Setting Editor.

[h2]Stuck at [i]trying to load animation and generate cache[/i] on startup[/h2]
If your computer has poor performance, the first time you start up or update the animation, the cache generation will indeed be slow, please be patient!

[h2]Stuck at [i]Loading Steam Workshop[/i] during startup[/h2]
If you have a bad internet connection, or are playing Steam Workshop, or are just unlucky, you may get stuck here for a while, I sometimes get stuck here for 1-5 minutes when I'm writing my own games, it's usually caused by internet fluctuations.
If you don't use the Creative Workshop mod, you can double-click the logo to skip it.

[h2]Win7 No screen after opening[/h2]
(It also works on Win10/11 with effects turned off, but it's usually a Win7 problem)
You need to turn on all animation effects in your system
Control Panel - System Properties - Performance. Activate the options "Enable desktop compositing" and "Use visual styles on Windows and buttons".
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43530340/1a3c7910f0137ebf171c81c58416c63c2c4c2857.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43530340/0a9c2ffb91de04d42e485223639515fa5c2ae02a.png[/img]
Related Video Tutorials
[previewyoutube=ATWx9ARI_Ic;leftthumb][/previewyoutube]

[h3]If it still won't open, you need to try compiling VPet's source code to locate the problem.
[/h3]
[h1]Compile VPet source code[/h1]
It's hard to fix bugs without error messages and locations, so if you're a little computer savvy, you can try manually compiling the VPet source code yourself to see if there are any problems.
Source: github [url=https://github.com/LorisYounger/VPet/]https://github.com/LorisYounger/VPet/[/url]

If you have problems trying to compile, or you find a specific error, please contact me at service@exlb.net or at [url=https://github.com/LorisYounger/VPet/issues]github issue[/url]. I'll try to fix it.

[h2]Requirements[/h2]
Win10 and above
20G or more space on C drive (if you change the installation location, you need 10G on C drive + 15G on other disks).

[h3]1. Install VisualStudio 2022[/h3]
Go to [url=https://visualstudio.microsoft.com/zh-hans/]https://visualstudio.microsoft.com[/url]
Download and install Visual Studio 2022 Community
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43530340/2f834dccfbc9827dd2b43c4cb89ce6a7ba1c0c9a.png[/img]
VisualStudio is the most comprehensive IDE developed by Microsoft for .NET and C# developers on Windows.

Just open it after downloading and install it, remembering to check [b]Net Desktop Development[/b] and [b]Universal Windows Platform Development[/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43530340/015aac9716836305f79e699bee53b57ad26470af.png[/img]

After that, go all the way to the next step and the installation is complete.
If you can't install it, it's a system problem, the program is a code editor developed by Microsoft.

[h3]2. Download VPet source code[/h3]
Source: github [url=https://github.com/LorisYounger/VPet/]https://github.com/LorisYounger/VPet/[/url]
Select download zip, then [b]unzip[/b]

Once extracted, double-click on `VPet.sln` to open the VPet source code.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43530340/689d3c06861cc2ea1a0e4dca8b311e2dec7d33f7.png[/img]

[h3]3. Start compiling[/h3]
In the upper left corner of VisualStudio select [i]X64[/i] and [i]VPet.Simulator.Windows[/i]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43530340/d0b8dfa3cf1cb5abd6a5f37851ef29136af185b4.png[/img]
Click the dark green Run button to run VPet source code.

If everything runs fine, the game will report an error [i]"缺少模组Core,无法启动桌宠\nMissing module Core, can't start up"[/i], as shown below
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43530340/0a8efb4d244c4c20fc74a13a1eaacf358ed4634f.png[/img]

Next, open the `VPet-Simulator.Windows` folder in the folder where the code is located.
Right click to run [i]mklink.bat[/i] as administrator

Next, re-click the dark green Run button to run the VPet source code, and it will run VPet normally!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43530340/6d92b4117ce42bb2ca3564272d504be32978471b.png[/img]

[h1]QA: Data Overflow[/h1]
[b]Q: Why are some players' stats going negative -9,223,372,035[/b]
If you find that your data suddenly overflows in this update, it's because this update fixes the fint calculation problem. In previous versions, although fint(long/1000000000) was used, it was calculated under double, so it didn't overflow.
In the latest version, this problem has been fixed, so that if the player's data exceeds 9,223,372,036, it will become a negative number.

[b]Q: What triggers this bug?[/b]
Only if the player's stats exceed 9,223,372,036, it will become a negative number, and as of VPet's original version, there is no such problem, but if one subscribes to a multilevel job, it will cause this problem if one is in a higher level job (eg: thousands or tens of thousands of levels).

[b]Q: I'm not cheating, why is this happening? [b]Q: I'm not cheating, why is this happening?[/b]
Because of the imperfections of the overmodel detection, the original purpose of the overmodel detection is to make the data seem to be able to develop normally and not lead to overflow, it is indeed the developer's problem to fail to detect it, and I didn't consider checking for jobs of 1000+ levels because the data was already overflowing, but I didn't realize that it wasn't because of the bugs. Higher level jobs + higher level profit rolls up, causing the data to eventually overflow, exponentially after all.
The newest version restricts jobs above level 1000, so you won't have this problem later on.

[b]Q: Blame the supermodel jobs for my data[/b]
It's mainly my problem, the mod author didn't realize that it's a bug to be able to get higher level, honestly I didn't know that the stats can be more than the maximum, it's too weird, please don't insult the mod author!

[b]Q: Data overflow, data is gone, compensate my daughter! [b]Q: Data overflow, data loss, pay for my daughter![/b]
There is no good solution for data overflow. There are several possible solutions
1. Roll back to version 1.9
In the Steam - Game Properties - Beta panel, select vpet_v1.9. Then enter the game and read the backup of the previous game.
Note: Version 1.9 will not be updated.
2. Currently the latest version
The latest update will automatically restore users with data overflow to level 100.
Note: There will be a tag added to the game archive when restoring, and the level/experience will be compensated according to the length of the game when we do the conversion/elitization function in the future.

[b]Q: Why don't you make a version without a data limit, and can you restore the previous bugs?[/b]
The computer is always overflowing with data, and if the data is too big, it's easy to get bugs.
The dangers of data overflow: 
1. easy to blow up the archive, the storage system is prone to bugs
2. click to talk and chat to talk system will not work (click not to talk, talk no option) (if the data is more than 2147483647)
3. UI will be misaligned, if the misalignment is serious, it may lead to error report.
4. Steam Leaderboards/Stats etc. Maximum data support public const int MaxValue = 2147483647; (This is why some people don't have Leaderboards)
5. The game itself is also more prone to strange bugs.

[b]Q: How to deal with the aftermath, after all, as long as the game is played, the data will be big[/b]
Currently there are several options
1. keep the current direction unchanged, limit the maximum profit, to ensure that in 100 years time will not reach the overflow value
2. add other parameters, such as (elitist/turn/etc.), in every 1000 levels to set a turn to ensure that the player data will not overflow
Feel free to vote in the comments, or make your own suggestions!

[b]Q: Is there any compensation for the big mistake you guys made?[/b]
Yes, it just so happens that before, in order to encourage Creative Workshop to make mods, I made a set of ChatGPT for Workshop ModMaker, this is the introduction: ChatGPT for Workshop ModMaker.

This is the introduction: ChatGPT for Workshop ModMaker is a chat service provided by the developer to reward and support Creative Workshop modders.
The ChatGPT service is paid for by the game developer.
The purpose of this plugin is to encourage everyone to make excellent mods.
[b]Creative Workshop Word Count Reward[/b]
Creative Workshop mods with 5 or more likes will be counted (1 stomp against 2 likes), and must be publicly visible mods.
1 Subscription = 200 Creative Workshop Words
1 Likes = 5000 Creative Workshop Words

On top of that, I've added a new reward
1 hour of gameplay (Steam) = 200 Creative Workshop words.

As compensation, the mod will be released in the future in the Creative Workshop, probably in the new year.

[h1]We apologize for any inconvenience caused by this incident, and we will continue to improve our skills, so please continue to support VPet Simulator[/h1].

notes.title: Commonly Fail to Open Solutions & Compile VPet Source Code
notes.content:
VPet problem solver is in the progress! It will allow you to solve some simple problems (eg: reset settings, change size, turn off mods, etc.).

[h1]Solutions to Common Problems[/h1]
Here are some solutions to common problems, the other VPet can be compatible with fault-tolerant has tried to be compatible with fault-tolerant

[h2]Win7 No screen after opening[/h2]
(It also works on Win10/11 with effects turned off, but it's usually a Win7 problem) [b]Thanks PabloV[/b]
You need to turn on all animation effects in your system
Control Panel - System Properties - Performance. Activate the options "Enable desktop compositing" and "Use visual styles on Windows and buttons".
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43530340/1a3c7910f0137ebf171c81c58416c63c2c4c2857.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43530340/0a9c2ffb91de04d42e485223639515fa5c2ae02a.png[/img]
Related Video Tutorials
[previewyoutube=ATWx9ARI_Ic;leftthumb][/previewyoutube]

[h2]Error: FIPS/uriString[/h2]
Errors are generally reported as follows.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43530340/82c5f00b3175ace05b48a584baec5d8eb8139454.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43530340/cacdfb46fb39aa05d68aadb9166c7b4b3cbe8565.png[/img]
The computer lacks FIPS related to lead to, the following provides by the network to collect the solution, by [url=https://blog.csdn.net/m0_46868092/article/details/117436852]ray ban wayfarer[/url]
It has been tested by players who have encountered the problem and have had no problems
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43530340/bf5c006def3e62d639d9f9d75cacb9562e97071c.png[/img]

1. Press WIN+R (or click Start-Run), type gpedit.msc and then OK to start the Group Policy Editor
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43530340/d69d2aa40d55f5a35ecbb7a5ac5723cdd92c1a36.png[/img]
2. In the list on the left go to Computer Configuration - Windows Settings - Security Settings - Local Policies - Security Options and on the right go to "System Encryption: Use FIPS-compliant algorithms for encryption, hashing, and signing."
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43530340/f6b3722bffa386a677273f485ab15bc3e886dc53.png[/img]
3. Double-click on the above policy and in the pop-up options, change the status to Disabled. Then close the group policy
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43530340/44038dccfdd85a543670620943645aa7c477cdc6.png[/img]
4. Press Win+R (or click Start-Run), type regedit and then OK to start the registry editor
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43530340/250e0feaba52469611bc6c3ea6f5b5b21e48939f.png[/img]
5. Browse to HKY_LOCAL_MACHINE\SYSTEM\CurrentControlSet\Control\Lsa\FipsAlgorithmPolicy, change the value of Enabled to 0 and OK
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43530340/6562fa1718dfd7aed7e02d00196f466e8afc9517.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43530340/1ffdc0f3fee7cc3d493c118186026b8b52929596.png[/img]

[h2]Startup is stuck at [i]Trying to load animation and generate cache[/i][/h2]
If your computer performance is poor, the first time you start or animation update, the generation of cache will be slower, please be patient, if after more than 20 minutes is still not good, you can refer to the above a tutorial

[h2]Startup is Stuck at [i]Loading Steam Workshop[/i] on startup[/h2]
If the network is not good, or is playing the Creative Workshop, or bad luck, will indeed be stuck here for a period of time, I write my own game sometimes also wait here for about 1-5 minutes, usually caused by network fluctuations.
If you still can't start it, you can try to start it without steam, and run VPet.Windows.exe directly when you close steam to see if there is any problem.

[h1]Compile VPet source code[/h1]
It's hard to fix bugs without error messages and locations, so if you're a little computer savvy, try compiling VPet's source code manually to see if there's a problem.
Source code address: github [url=https://github.com/LorisYounger/VPet/]https://github.com/LorisYounger/VPet/[/url] 

[h2]Requirements[/h2]
Win10 and above
disk C with more than 10G of space

[h3]1. Install VisualStudio[/h3]
Go to [url=https://visualstudio.microsoft.com/]https://visualstudio.microsoft.com[/url]
Download and install Visual Studio 2022 Community
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43530340/2f834dccfbc9827dd2b43c4cb89ce6a7ba1c0c9a.png[/img]
VisualStudio is the most comprehensive IDE developed by Microsoft for .NET and C# developers on Windows.

Once downloaded, open it and install it, remembering to check the [b].Net Desktop[/b] box.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43530340/557fcf50b7b8e2c429f8ab5a332fa158ec2f2484.png[/img]

After that, you can go all the way to the next step and the installation will be finished.

[h3]2. Download VPet source code[/h3]
Source code address github [url=https://github.com/LorisYounger/VPet/]https://github.com/LorisYounger/VPet/[/url] 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43530340/d34cbb748390a82665e5d0af74d67838b1ba3952.png[/img]
Select download zip, and then [b]unzip[/b]

Double-click `VPet.sln` after decompression to open VPet source code.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43530340/689d3c06861cc2ea1a0e4dca8b311e2dec7d33f7.png[/img]

[h3]3. Start compiling[/h3]
Select [i]X64[/i] and [i]VPet.Simulator.Windows[/i] in the upper left corner of VisualStudio.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43530340/d0b8dfa3cf1cb5abd6a5f37851ef29136af185b4.png[/img]
Click the dark green Run button to run the VPet source code.

If everything runs fine, the game will report an error [i]"缺少模组Core,无法启动桌宠\nMissing module Core, can't start up"[/i], as shown here
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43530340/0a8efb4d244c4c20fc74a13a1eaacf358ed4634f.png[/img]

Next, open the `VPet-Simulator.Windows` folder in the folder directory where the code is located.
Right click to run as administrator [i]mklink.bat[/i]
The result of the run is shown in the following figure:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43530340/cc2e247097173f3c167bef3799b25ec8588572a6.png[/img]

Next, re-click the dark green Run button to run the VPet source code, you can run VPet normally!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43530340/6d92b4117ce42bb2ca3564272d504be32978471b.png[/img]

notes.content:
There's been no notification of game updates lately, not that I've been secretly update on them, but I've been too lazy to write an update document. (lol)
Details of the updated changes can be found directly in [url=https://github.com/LorisYounger/VPet/commits/main]github commits[/url]
This is real time.

[h1]Animation Updates[/h1]
[h2]New play types: play games/delete bugs[/h2]
Playing the game type doesn't drop moods, and consumes less thirst and hunger.

[h2]Other new animations[/h2]
Such as dancing, new normal loop animations, sad walking, etc.

[h2]Where's the gift? [/h2]
Gifts are still working on, the code and animations are complete, just need to plan to provide gift items, the whole thing will be pushed up!

[h1]Code update[/h1]
[h2]ChatGPTAPI support for feedback based on status/good feelings[/h2]
Also supports selecting model GPT3/4
Added status and favorability parameters to the chat front to make the CGPT feedback more realistic.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43530340/71bf0f1e7b00e3d85b91053ca24851291d84addf.gif[/img]

[h2]New optional chat[/h2]
Replaces the previous official API (which cost me 80$ and I'm out of luck, so get off the line).
New Option Chat allows you to ask your table favor by selecting a fixed question, different questions and answers will affect the mood/favorability parameters
Support for Creative Workshop to add more options and answers.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43530340/424637ad58be2670b45f997ce9ada29c72baad53.gif[/img]

[h2]Hash check and supermod check[/h2]
Added features such as supermod checking and auto-calculation of supermod data. And for players who don't use supermods, a small label is provided for showing off.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43530340/7466818c7831398cc1a494e8733befcbfa4a18a0.png[/img]
If you want to restart the game, you can do so in Settings - System - NewGame.
Players don't need to worry about whether or not they're using a supermodel mod, as the default settings automatically calculate supermodel data, meaning you're unlikely to encounter problems with missing markers.
Even if you are using an overmodel mod, you don't need to worry about whether or not it will affect your achievements. 
The overmodel check does not affect the unlocking of achievements. However, using an overmodel mod may cause the game to report errors (data overflow) or prevent achievements from being unlocked properly (e.g. stats not working for negative items).

[h2]MOD supports animations for food/drinks/items[/h2]
The mod now supports animations, for example, the functional drink here becomes a drinking animation.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43530340/b4256a98c2f1d449f3434d118d84748b718c51f9.gif[/img]

[h2]Support for pets to buy their own food[/h2].
Pets will now buy their own food, but there is a take-out fee.
As for the mood response, I will change it when the gift comes out in the future.
Although the description says that the pet will eat food indiscriminately, but in fact, it will not, the pet will only eat more than $10.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43530340/f9eaa1995d6bce8687eabf289269cc1fe56abd90.gif[/img]

It's still being tweaked, and it's actually working, but I haven't finished writing it yet (English translation, etc.).

notes.title: Official Update Planner
notes.content:
Since the official version of "VPet Simulator" was launched, it has gained more attention than expected, and the number of people online has exceeded that of most games, according to the current data. So we need to change the situation that we have been making games based on interest, and become slightly more formal, for me, now that the game audience is so large, the game has become everyone's game, as the saying goes, the game industry is also a service industry, and we need to serve the players as the core, instead of the attitude of my game I make the decision, which will make the game die at light speed

[h2]Core issues[/h2]
[h3]BUG[/h3]
Currently, I have fixed a lot of bugs that prevented it from starting, and a lot of bugs that reported, but there are still some bugs that prevent it from starting due to system/environmental reasons. After all, there are only one programmer, and I get tens of thousands of feedbacks every day, so I'll keep fixing these bugs according to priority and difficulty. I've also recruited some new programmers to help me maintain it.
If you know C# and WPF, you are welcome to fix the bugs together. The project address: https://github.com/LorisYounger/VPet

[h3]Creative Workshop Tutorial[/h3]
Creative Workshop tutorials are in the works, as well as a modding tool that is being developed
[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43530340/ab22516a578c09e43028788e41c4820db67c7e48.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43530340/779c13211c839abc19393ce2f195eb368e091d51.png[/img][/url]

[h3]Chat & Server[/h3]

notes.title: Frequently asked Questions Q&A
notes.content:
[h3]I don't know how to use it.[/h3]
You can check the tutorials that come with TablePet.

[h3]Crashes/fails to open on first startup
[/h3]I've fixed a lot of bugs that could cause startup crashes, but there are still a lot of mods that won't open, I'm still trying to fix them!
If you know a little bit about computers, you can try to download VisualStudio and compile the code to see if there are any specific error messages.
Send it to github/issues or give it to me.

[h3]Is it possible to run the game without launching from Steam?
[/h3]Yes, just run VPet-Simulator.Windows.exe.

[h3]Stuttering animations
[/h3]If you find all animations stuttering, it's a TablePets feature and you have to try it (
If only some animations are stuttering, please send me feedback.

[h3]TablePet mouse attachment
[/h3]We have tried to fix this bug several times, but if you still encounter it, you can click the mouse here to get rid of it.

[h3]Playing the game affects the field of view, want to hide behind the game screen
[/h3]You can disable it in the settings

[h3]Does playing games affect the frame rate?
[/h3]Depends on the computer, you can check the usage in the task manager.

[h3]Mistakenly eat earth, solar system
[/h3]The latest update removes the negative effects of Earth and Solar System, but the experience points are still deducted.
Delete 'Save.lps' from the game's root directory, empty the archive and start over.

[h3]What can you do if your pet is sick and you don't have money?
[/h3]Eat Earth and Solar System to save the archive, but you'll lose experience.
Delete 'Save.lps' from the game's root directory to empty the archive and start over.

[h3]There are three bars on the right side of the better buy menu, click on them to see the properties of the food.[/h3]

[h3]Popup error code when chat[/h3]
[h3]Chat error when using author API.[/h3]
Because the service I provide is overloaded, it's always running at full capacity.
Don't worry about these errors, just wait a while and try again. Or use your own API.

[h3]Why is it that when you eat or drink, half of your messages come back?
[/h3]The other half is slow to come back.

[h3]Problems with food validity/preference
[/h3]When you eat something, your validity drops, but it slowly recovers over time.
Validity affects how efficiently you get your stats, which simply means that you need to eat more of different things.

[h3]Check health and favorability
[/h3]This is a hidden value, you can see it directly according to the performance of your table pet.

[h3]Can the V-pet talk?
[/h3]Creative Commons subscribe to Edge-TTS, you can turn it on in the settings. 
https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=3018320779

[h3]Does the higher the level, the faster I can earn money while broadcasting and working?
[/h3]Yes

[h3]How does VPet dance?
[/h3]The table pet will automatically dance when the music is playing and the table pet doesn't do anything else, you can set the trigger volume and other settings in the settings.
If you don't support volume capture, the volume capture will show -1.

[h3]Payment Issues
[/h3]There will be paid DLC in the future (Traveling Pets, Pets Community, etc.).
The main game is always free, and will not be changed to paid.
If the server problem is solved, there may be paid ChatGPT in-app purchases.

[h3]Donation Issues
[/h3]Since the game will add paid dlc and other services in the future, we do not accept donations, thank you for your kind words.

[h3]How to not show running like wallpaper?
[/h3]Delete Steam.dll and Steam_x64.dll to get out of steam.
If you run VPet-Simulator.Windows.exe without starting Steam, you can start it as well.
